ticks.note: Tick 1 starts the chart: it enters the initial state, `Off`, and `light` gets its initial value, false.
The chart reads `button`: true. The transition out of `Off` fires, `light` becomes true and the chart is now in `On`. The input and the output it caused belong to the same tick.
`button` is false, so nothing fires. The chart stays in `On` and `light` keeps its value, true.
No input changed: `button` is still false. The tick still happens; the chart looks, finds nothing to do, and keeps everything as it was.
`button` is true again. Now the transition out of `On` fires: `light` becomes false and the chart is back in `Off`.
